And the feminine affix ङीष् comes after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) expressive of जाति , followed by the following 1. पाक 'cooked' 2. कर्ण 'ear' 3. पुष्प 'flower' 4. फल 'fruit' 5. मूल 'root' 6. बाल 'youth'

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीष्

The affix ठक् comes after a word in the Accusative -2nd case in construction denoting birds, fishes or wild beasts, when the sense is 'who kills that'.

Terms: ठक्

The affix ति comes in the sense of 'the root of it' after the word पक्ष in the Genitive 6th-Case in construction.

Terms: ति
